In The Binding of Isaac, players are given items to use to make themselves more powerful in this randomly generated dungeon. Those three items are from the characters dead cat called"Guppy". If a player can get 3 Guppy items, than they go through a transformation and become very powerful (flight, more damage, etc). The problem in this picture is that the cat's head and its tail both cost 1 of my maximum hearts. If you look at the top of the screen you will see I have 1 empty heart and 1 full heart, but I still only have a maximum of 2 hearts to give for the trade. If I were to take all three items here, then I would die because I would have no health left.

That is why I was so frustrated to see these 3 items that would make me very powerful, yet still kill me and end my run through of this particular play-through.
